LESSON: ORDERING CLASSIFICATION

Grade: PP1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Ordering CLASSIFICATION

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Ordering CLASSIFICATION. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. differentiate objects of different sizes in the environment
2. use appropriate vocabulary related to ordering for effective communication
3. arrange objects according to size in ascending order up to 3 objects for 48 making comparison of objects of different sizes e) arrange objects according to size in descending order up to 3 objects for making comparison of objects of different sizes f) organize different objects in the environment g) appreciate different objects or materials in the environment.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. differentiate objects of different sizes in the environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to differentiate objects of different sizes in the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. use appropriate vocabulary related to ordering for effective communication
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate vocabulary related to ordering for effective communication. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. arrange objects according to size in ascending order up to 3 objects for 48 making comparison of objects of different sizes e) arrange objects according to size in descending order up to 3 objects for making comparison of objects of different sizes f) organize different objects in the environment g) appreciate different objects or materials in the environment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to arrange objects according to size in ascending order up to 3 objects for 48 making comparison of objects of different sizes e) arrange objects according to size in descending order up to 3 objects for making comparison of objects of different sizes f) organize different objects in the environment g) appreciate different objects or materials in the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Ordering CLASSIFICATION.
2. Explain Ordering CLASSIFICATION to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Ordering CLASSIFICATION.
4. Show that you can: differentiate objects of different sizes in the environment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Ordering CLASSIFICATION. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Ordering CLASSIFICATION important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. differentiate objects of different sizes in the environment
2. use appropriate vocabulary related to ordering for effective communication
3. arrange objects according to size in ascending order up to 3 objects for 48 making comparison of objects of different sizes e) arrange objects according to size in descending order up to 3 objects for making comparison of objects of different sizes f) organize different objects in the environment g) appreciate different objects or materials in the environment.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
